newsitem.title: USA: Alex. Brown up on takeover rumors - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Alex. Brown up on takeover rumors - analysts.

text.p: Shares of retail brokerage firm Alex. Brown Inc jumped Thursday on market rumors of a possible takeover by Bankers Trust New York Corp, analyts and traders said.
Alex. Brown gained 2-3/8 to 43-3/4. Bankers Trust gained 1-1/8 to 82. Alex. Brown officials could not be reached for comment. Bankers Trust said it has a policy of not commenting on market rumors.
While Baltimore-based Alex. Brown often has been cited as a likely acquisition target, rumors linking the firm to Bankers Trust have intensified in the past few days, analysts said.
A merger between Alex. Brown and Bankers Trust would bear a resemblance to the proposed merger between Morgan Stanley Group Inc and Dean Witter Discover & Co, analysts said.

That deal, announced in February, aims to combine Dean Witter's strong retail brokerage presence and Morgan Stanley's investment banking strength in the biggest merger seen in the securities industry.
Buying a retail brokerage firm gives an investment banking house an immediate and relatively inexpensive way to enter the business, instead of building a retail presence from scratch, analysts said.

But Alex. Brown is only one of many potential takeover targets, analysts said. Other possible targets also rallied Thursday, while the Dow Jones industrials showed a 55 point decline to 6461. Legg Mason Inc gained one to 29-1/8, A.G. Edwards Inc added 3/4 to 32-1/2 and PaineWebber Group Inc gained 3/4 to 32-1/2.
